_doc: 5 Science Facts (Mohd Ashaar), revised take (4K, 75.3s, no World Science Day angle). Audio pieces in order; cuts inside a fact sit under B-roll. Every piece ends after its last word has died away. Revision 3: closing line restored ('…and follow for more science'), voice 1.08x to stay under 60s. Revision 4: 50s total. Pauses inside a line play 3x faster; each section's speech speed is set from its speaking rate (slower lines sped up more, 1.12-1.30x), solved so the reel lands on 50s.
_doc_rev5: Revision 5: speeds fixed at the revision-4 values (section_speed), except two lines that played too fast: the intro 'Hi, I am Mohd Ashaar, science educator at The Cub' (1.10x) and the honey fact's 'Honey found in ancient Egyptian tombs, thousands of years old, was reportedly still good to eat' (1.14x).
_doc_rev6: Revision 6: 'Today I am sharing the five facts that will surprise you' restored; the intro is now one continuous take (5.00-14.45s), the restored line at 1.20x.
